paragraphs: Rav Pappi. R' Abba ben Pappi; Avimi ben Pappi; Rav Huna ben Pappi; Rav Zuti of Rav Pappi's household; R' Hiyya ben Pappi; R' Hanina ben Pappi; Rava ben Pappi.
Since Rav Pappi is mentioned without qualification, and it is uncertain whether he is the first or the second, understand and discern according to the generations.

R' Abba bar Yaakov: Rav Pappi overturned his ruling. Abaye: see shortly, Ravin. Rav Ashi said, ‘When we were in Rav Pappi's house’: Hullin 82a. He referred to Rav Bibi bar Abaye as “master.” Huna bar Tahlifa. Rav Huna bar Rav Yehoshua (see R' Nehemya bar Yosef). Mar Zutra said, ‘I saw Rav Pappi’: Sukkah 46a. R’ Yehoshua of Sikhnin. Also Rav Yitzhak bar Yosi. R' Yirmeyah said, ‘Rav Pappi acted in practice.’ Rav Kahana said to Rav Pappi, or, according to another version, to Rav Zevid: Sotah 45a; Bava Metzia 101a. R' Levi said that Rav Pappi said in R' Yehoshua of Sikhnin's name: Bava Batra 75b. Shabbat 151b: R' Levi said that Rav Pappi said that R' Yehoshua said; in Rif, ‘of Sikhnin.’ Rav Mesharshiya of Tusanya sent him the question, “Let our teacher instruct us.” Rav Nehemya bar R' Yehoshua. R' Nehemya bar R' Yosef (see there), and with Rav Pappa. In Rava's name: Shabbat 93, end of a; Megillah 26, end of b; Yoma 62a; Pesahim 7, end of a; Bava Batra 126a; Avodah Zarah 4a. Ravin, R’ Yitzhak, and Abaye happened to come to Rav Pappi’s house [as reported here] Ravina spoke to him: Bava Metzia 49a. Ravina's father in his name. He happened to come to Mar Shmuel's house: Beitzah 14b.
